title: Detector, Assets, and Static UI
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of actual detect.py flow, image/audio assets, and disconnected page, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in currency-note-recognition-for-visually-impaired.
learning_objectives: Explain actual detect.py flow, image/audio assets, and disconnected page in plain language and connect it to index.html; js/app.js; server.py; detector.py.
Trace one input through the detector, assets, and static ui stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: actual detect.py flow, image/audio assets, and disconnected page
practical_outcomes: Trace the detector, assets, and static ui stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for actual detect.py flow, image/audio assets, and disconnected page.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
